compute_so3_relative_angle: compute the relative angle in radians between two batches of 3x3 rotation matrices R1 and R2
compute_so3_rotation_angle: compute the rotation angle in radians from a batch of 3x3 rotation matrices using trace and acos
convert_so3_exp_map: convert a batch of 3D log-rotation vectors to 3x3 rotation matrices using the SO3 exponential map
convert_so3_log_map: convert a batch of 3x3 rotation matrices to 3D log-rotation vectors using the SO3 logarithmic map
compute_hat_operator: compute the hat operator converting a batch of 3D vectors into skew-symmetric 3x3 matrices
